		Dataset Summary
	

ByteDance Robot Benchmark (BDRBench-20) is a vision-language-action (VLA) dataset containing 8K high-quality trajectories. It was created to evaluate the performance of VLA models in real-world scenarios. This dataset includes 20 common manipulation tasks, such as pick-and-place, pouring, and open/close actions. The dataset is designed to be used for training and evaluating VLA models… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/robovlms/bytedance_robot_benchmark_20.
reputation: An emerging benchmark from ByteDance used in vision-language-action and robot manipulation research with growing adoption.
